verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is a cloud browser automation platform, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a fair axis. The pack has no evidence of versioned automation definitions, change review or rollback. Session recordings (replay to debug) and profiles (saved browser state) are adjacent features: they review runs and persist state, not automation versions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
